faq.subtitle: Have questions? We've got answers. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.

q1.question: How long does it take to get started?
q1.answer: You can create an account and start using LYNVIA DIGITAL in less than 5 minutes. Our intuitive onboarding process guides you through setup.

q2.question: Is my data secure?
q2.answer: Absolutely. We use bank-level 256-bit encryption, regular security audits, and comply with all major legal industry standards including SOC 2 Type II.

q3.question: Can I import my existing data?
q3.answer: Yes! We support data import from most practice management systems. Our team can help with migration at no extra cost.

q4.question: What kind of support do you offer?
q4.answer: We provide email support for all plans, with priority support for Professional and Enterprise tiers. Enterprise customers get a dedicated account manager.

q5.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q5.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time with no penalties. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period.

q6.question: Do you offer training?
q6.answer: We provide comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and webinars. Enterprise customers receive personalized onboarding and training sessions.
